messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> page fired: service=inference-queue-high, severity=sev2, region=eu-west-1. Symptoms: embedding workers 5xx spike, queue depth rising. PagerURL: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD12345

maria (oncall): acked and on it. starting triage — checking autoscaler and kvcache metrics.

derek (sre): +1 i can help with scaling if needed. any obvious recent deploys?

maria (oncall): not that I can see in the last 30m. rolling logs show a lot of backend 502/504 from embedder pods. snippet:

```
2026-03-17T12:07:02Z embedder-3 error: downstream connection reset
2026-03-17T12:07:04Z embedder-7 error: OOMKilled
2026-03-17T12:07:09Z router warn: request queue depth=120
```

maria (oncall): running: `kubectl get hpa -n inference` and `kubectl get pods -l app=embedder -n inference` now.

pagerduty: auto-ack by maria (oncall). escalation halted.

maria (oncall): initial mitigation: scaling embedder deployment to 10 replicas and temporarily pinning to smaller seq-length model for high-throughput routes. running command: `kubectl scale deployment/embedder --replicas=10 -n inference`

sam (support): cascading customer signals: Support reported 3 customers seeing error spikes (CustomerX, CustomerY). CustomerX is in EU and raised a ticket. cc: @sam for customer comms.

derek (sre): I see 2 pods in CrashLoopBackOff caused by OOMs. pushing a quick hotfix: reduce per-pod batch size env var and restart pods. patch applied to canary.

maria (oncall): canary looks ok — no new OOMs in last 2m. CPU stable. queue depth dropping from 120 -> 35.

sam (support): drafted update for CustomerX: "We're investigating elevated errors for embeddings in EU. We've applied scaling and mitigations; we expect recovery in ~10-15 minutes. Will update you in 15min." Want me to send?

maria (oncall): please send. add that we will follow up with RCA and any regression markers. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: note: incident priority set to P2.

derek (sre): leaving a short runbook entry in incident notes:
- scale embedder to +X replicas
- if OOM persists, deploy smaller batch config: BATCH_SIZE=8
- fallback route: route /embed -> embedder-lite variant

maria (oncall): handing over to derek for stabilization/cleanup. derek, can you own postmortem and check why k8s node memory spike happened? I'm switching to follow mode.

derek (sre): taking ownership. i'll collect logs and check node metrics, also check quantization rollback history. will ping when I've got a timeline.

sam (support): sent update to CustomerX. customer replied: "thanks, we see reduced errors."

maria (oncall): thanks team. marking thread as ongoing -> assigned to derek. leaving a short note in PD: "Acked by maria, derek owning follow-up."

derek (sre): quick status ping in 20m with findings. planning to keep embedder scaled until root cause identified.

incident-bot: closed autoescalation for now. remember to attach perf traces and eval prompts to the postmortem.

maria (oncall): final: queue depth stable ~12, 5xx rate back to normal. leaving oncall. :white_check_mark:

messages_end:
